column3: The initial calling is expressed as a completed action.
You are asked not to incline my heart; it is not phrased as allowing it to be drawn.
The righteous person’s striking is called kindness. My head is explicitly the subject asked not to refuse the oil.
Their judges have been thrown down; there is no separate when clause or explicit the people as the following subject.
Taking refuge is expressed as completed; the final image is not laying my soul bare.
The trap is singular and is figuratively described as having hands.
The nets have a singular possessor. Together and until I pass are expressed; in safety is not a separate phrase.
